name: audio_mix
description: Combine a video (or audio) with another audio file. mode mix (default) lays the audio under the original sound, at 30% volume by default, which is right for background music; duck lowers the music automatically whenever the original audio (speech) is loud. mode replace swaps the soundtrack entirely. The added audio loops to fill the video, can start later (start_at) and fades out at the end.

input.description: The main video or audio file, relative to the workspace. Its length decides the output length.

audio.description: The music, voice-over or soundtrack to add, relative to the workspace.

audio_volume.description: Volume multiplier for the added audio. Default 0.3 for mix, 1 for replace.

input_volume.description: Volume multiplier for the original audio. Default 1.

start_at.description: When the added audio begins in the main file. Default 0. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

loop.description: Loop the added audio if it is shorter. Default true.

duck.description: Lower the added audio while the original is loud (speech). Default false.

fade_out.description: Fade the added audio out over this long at the end. Default 2 s when it is cut off. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format. Default: next to the input as <name>_mixed.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
